# acli-py api

## `acli-py api`

Call any Jira REST endpoint with your credentials and print the JSON.

Writes honour --dry-run like every other command.

```text
acli-py api METHOD PATH [OPTIONS]
```

```sh
acli-py api GET myself
acli-py api POST /rest/api/3/issue -d @issue.json --dry-run
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `METHOD` | required | GET, POST, PUT, DELETE or PATCH. |
| `PATH` | required | Path, e.g. /rest/api/3/myself or just myself. |
| `-d`, `--data` `TEXT` |  | JSON body, or @file, or '-' for stdin. |
| `-q`, `--query` `TEXT` |  | Query parameter KEY=VALUE. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |
